text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
The food, cake, tea, and presents— it 
looks like they all reached the room 
safely. Let's celebrate properly once we 
get back, Orfe.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Splendid. You have done well, dear sister.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
This is the least I could do. After all, 
it's Orfe's birthday.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Today is filled with nothing but special, 
precious memories— Fufu, just thinking 
back on it makes me so happy.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Like, you know, back then... Shortly 
before Or started racing... When I asked 
Or what she wanted—"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"A crown fit for the world," huh... Fufu, 
you were already acting like a king back 
then, Orfe.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I must disagree, dear sister. She is far 
too childish to be called a king.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
A true king is naturally offered a crown. 
To beg others for one—is not the way of a 
king.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, as expected of Orfe... With every 
passing year, coming closer to perfection 
as 'King'—!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
However, I have no recollection of it. 
Though if my elder sister says so, it must 
have happened—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, don't worry about it, Orfe. I just 
remembered it on my own...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
(Yes. I simply remember it all, completely 
on my own. Because to me, the Orfevre of 
that day is special and precious—)
